 ORDER

The police after investigation, submitted the charge sheet for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 342 R/w Section 34 of IPC and Section 3(1)(11) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (for short 'SC/ST (PA) Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners herein, who were initially arraigned as accused in the FIR were dropped from the array of accused in the charge sheet.
Accused Nos.2 to 5 approached this Court in Criminal Revision Petition No.200011/2018 and this Court, by order dated 03.12.2018 quashed the proceedings against accused Nos.2 to 5.
However, observed that, Trial Court shall proceed with the trial against accused Nos.1, 6 and 7 in accordance with law.
Thereafter, the learned Sessions Court in view of the observation made by this Court, has issued summons to the present petitioners/accused Nos.6 and .
Hence, this petition.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1- State and learned Amicus Curie for respondent No.2.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:5567 3.

Petitioners, who were arrayed as accused Nos.6 and 7 in the FIR were dropped from the array of accused in the charge sheet filed by the police after investigation, since no incriminating materials were found against them.
This Court while disposing of the revision petition filed by accused Nos.2 to 5 has observed that the Trial Court shall proceed with the trial against accused Nos.1, 6 and 7 in accordance with law.

4. The petitioners having been dropped from array of the accused in the charge sheet, the summons issued by the learned Sessions Court to answer the charge of offence alleged in the charge sheet is not sustainable in law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
